commit.message: Proof simplification proposal(s)
Proof simplification proposal(s)

Derive finite initialization strip walls and exact horizontal reset alternatives

Find the first departures from both actual initializer tails using horizontal periodicity. Prove both exact seam tuples, all intervening tiles and explicit wall bounds from Allowed matching plus Start alone, without supplied boundaries or a globally unique Start.

Classify horizontal color1 as reset or genuine seam and preserve the nonseam premise needed for complete reset recovery. Record root full-source review, four fresh bounded Lean replays and thirteen standard-only axiom reports. Distinguish the seeded post-first-step initialization from an all-zero row and retain run extraction as open work.

Derive fixed strip walls and a seam-free interior through all integer times

Identify the exact initial tile at every integer interior coordinate and preserve the seeded South row with symbol1 at zero and operating head color4 at one. Combine actual vertical matching and seam invariance to prove persistent seam walls and exclude seams everywhere inside for all past and future times.

Export existence from the actual MarkedWord alone, deriving its finite initial strip rather than supplying boundaries, global Start uniqueness or rectangular geometry. Record complete author review, clean final bounded main/check builds and five standard-only axiom audits. Keep machine-run extraction and full consistency equivalence open.
Proof simplification proposal(s)

Place five more DiophantineConsistency Lean proof-simplification packets

Five drop-zone archives of 26 October 2026, all reviewing commit
60e9c5d620, are placed beside the first packet under
Computability/DiophantineConsistency/research/:

- 20261026b: diophantine-lean-simplification-2026-10-26.zip (e73fa2e916)
- 20261026c: lean-proof-simplification-2026-10-26.zip (5cec32d593)
- 20261026d: lean-proof-simplification-2026-10-26 (2).zip (3eba4845d8)
- 20261026e: Lean_Proof_Simplification_2026-10-26.zip (b310142330)
- 20261026f: ProveIt_Lean_Proof_Simplification_2026-10-26.zip (b310142330)

1,793 members in all. 1,513 are byte-identical to a Git blob of the
reviewed commit or of HEAD, mostly the bundled source snapshots in e and
f, and are not copied. Each placement's OMITTED.tsv lists those members
with their blob hash and a repository path holding the same bytes, so
every member stays recoverable. One remaining member is excluded by an
ignore rule. Each PLACEMENT.md records the arrival and points to the
shared ADOPTION.md. The five ZIPs are retired, and the docs/incoming
README now tabulates all six placements. No supplied script or Lean
file was run for placement.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Bind the actual first machine step and exact configuration color semantics

Transport the authenticated first decoded action into the literal machine transition, prove clock1 state/head/tape and every integer tape reading, and identify runs started at that exact initialized configuration with the original clock shifted by one.

Define the literal state/head/plain color encoding including halt215, prove bounds and state/bit injectivity, and retain write/move-before-halt semantics with both halted colors. Match the actual initialization components without an all-blank post-step assumption. Record four fresh independent Lean replays, thirty-six standard-only audits and the independent strip-geometry review; keep full row/run extraction open.

Merge origin/main with five additional archived proof-simplification packets

Preserve the concurrently published research and intake changes without applying their proposed patches. The active Lean tree, dependency pins, maintained equation and freshly verified strip/machine proofs are unchanged by the incoming archive placement.

Decode exact tile inputs and derive uniform finish rows from one event

Bind each operating head input to its actual transition index while preserving every locally valid plain/halt pass, finish and receive alternative, including target215. Prove generic open-integer-interval propagation and use the exact reset grammar in both directions.

Derive an entire finish row and following reset row from one interior south438 edge using actual time matching and seam-free geometry, without assuming uniformity, event existence or a machine run. Record full independent source review, four fresh Lean replays and eighteen standard-only axiom audits.

Identify the actual clock1 row and rule out premature finishes in operating rows

Define interval row encoding with only interior head position and actual configuration colors. Derive the first encoded row and persistent strip from MarkedWord alone, retaining the actual decimal run at clock1 rather than supplying an initialization or run-correspondence premise.

Force the operating head tile by its actual input index and derive its Boolean South output. Show that any alleged interior finish would propagate across the row and contradict that output, so absence of finishes is a conclusion rather than an assumed clean-row invariant. Record full author review, four successful final bounded Lean checks and ten standard-only axiom audits.

Reuse general population and coefficient bounds in Lean proofs

Remove49 proof-body lines across four existing modules. Specialize the general half-base theorem for31 coordinates, use List/Finset library facts for range sums and support filters, and use Nat.mul_ofDigits for repunit scaling. Reuse binary-shift and power-product identities for the remaining mask arithmetic.

All theorem statements, hypotheses, definitions and imports are unchanged. Four final source/olean checks and four existing example/axiom check modules pass Lean4.32.0; independent source/diff review passes. Retain the original explicit triangle proof after the candidate term exceeded the default elaboration budget, without raising any limits. Record scope and verification in the iteration review.

Simplify polynomial specialization and positive-domain proof transport

Reuse Fin.comp_cons and Fin.cons_self_tail for input specialization, and normalize the positive-domain integer-to-natural cast pointwise. Remove11 proof-body lines across Polynomial and PositiveDomain while retaining every definition, theorem statement, witness map and hypothesis.

Both changed modules, ZFC and PositiveZFC clients, and the focused specialization/domain axiom audit pass Lean. ROOT reviewed both complete files and their diffs; record the author-observed checks and their scope in the shared iteration review.

Simplify Pell sign, divisibility and bootstrap bound proofs

Remove37 proof-body lines across NativePellStepDown, NativePellBootstrap, NativePellFirstIndex and NativePellPower. Reuse firstQ_pos, product-order lemmas, Or.imp, integer divisibility closure and the natAbs square identity; let omega handle linear casts directly.

Keep all definitions, theorem statements, imports and hypotheses fixed. All four rebuilt modules, four existing regression/axiom checks and three dependent modules pass Lean;46 theorem axiom reports use standard axioms only. ROOT and an independent peer reviewed the changed sign cases, cast recovery and final source bytes. Record the exact validation scope in the iteration review.

Gather the six Lean proof-simplification packets in one directory

The six DiophantineConsistency proof-simplification packets of 26 October
now live under research/lean-proof-simplification/:
- lean-proof-simplification-20261026 becomes 2026-10-26a.
- lean-proof-simplification-20261026b..f become 2026-10-26b..f.

A new README.md indexes them by archive, arrival and reviewed commit. The
shared ADOPTION.md moves to the directory's top level and now covers all
six packets. It records what is applied and in validation, what is
pending, and what is deferred or superseded and why. The PLACEMENT.md
links and the docs/incoming README table point to the new paths.
Packet contents are unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'

Reuse supplied equations under primitive recursion in correctness proofs

Adopt the checked PR-congruence proposal in three maintained modules, removing34 lines of duplicated Nat.rec congruence induction. Keep executable syntax, evaluators, optimizer behavior and both returned .prec program constructors unchanged.

All three module/olean checks, ScalarPRRepresentation, ProgramOptimization, CompilerAxioms and two executable-value rfl checks pass Lean. ROOT reviewed complete final sources. Document the explicit standard-axiom footprint increase from rewriting under binders, and add an adoption record without altering original packet evidence.

Replace the generated Short* degree certificates by a total-degree tactic

The four totalDegree certificates in ShortSystem (P77, P75), ShortFrontier
(P73) and ShortReducedStrong (P76) were generated let/have chains, about
1,150 lines with one `have` per circuit gate. They are replaced by
`total_degree_bound`, a small tactic in the new module TotalDegreeBound.
It reads a degree bound off the syntax tree of an explicit MvPolynomial
expression: variables count one, constants and numerals zero, sums take
the maximum, products add, and powers multiply. Each step is a lemma
application, the numeric side conditions are closed by `decide`, and
shared subterms are bounded once.

Two certificates relied on a cancellation that a syntactic bound cannot
see. Each now states it as one ring identity:
- ShortFrontier.core_n1: the main norm has degree 18, not 22.
- ShortReducedStrong.correctedStrong_core: the corrected strong
  coefficient has degree 20, not 22.
The theorem statements (degree <= 68, 68, 80, 64) are unchanged.

The generators tools/build_sos_circuit.py, build_reduced_strong.py and
build_frontier_circuit.py no longer emit the degree blocks. They still
splice the literal evaluators. Previously build_sos_circuit.py would also
have re-appended a deleted certificate.

NativeArithmetic52.eq_lift_of_zero: fifteen have/change pairs become
typed haves, and the 31 bullets after fin_cases become
`fin_cases i <;> first | rfl | assumption`.

Net: 7 files, +67/-1,431 lines, plus the 120-line tactic module.

Checked with LAKE_JOBS=1 and LEAN_NUM_THREADS=0, one module per lake
invocation: lake build of +DiophantineConsistency.ShortFrontier
(rebuilding TotalDegreeBound and ShortSystem), ShortReducedStrong,
NativeArithmetic52, and the ShortSystem dependents Carrier65Checks and
Carrier66Checks; all green.

Proof simplification proposal(s)

Share natural assignment transport across representation constructors

Adopt the common natAssignment_comp_map proof in Representation and reuse it in the quartic compiler. Remove26 lines including the new common lemma, replacing repeated extensional assignment equalities in reindexing, conjunction and disjunction. Witness counts, arithmetic expressions, evaluators and existing theorem statements stay fixed.

Both rebuilt modules, three representation clients, RepresentationSize, QuarticCost and two axiom audits pass Lean. ROOT reviewed the full representation module and changed compiler proof in context. Record current-source adoption, standard axioms and the731-byte net reduction.

Bind operational color updates to actual transition signals and receiver targets

Prove the exact new-head, written-old-head and unchanged-cell color formula, including write/move before halt. Authenticate the actual machine transition to the literal cached action and its bounded numeric target, exposing write, direction and next-state color without reevaluating the decimal numeral.

Exclude receive/receive ghost signals at plain inputs and force the exact actual receiver in both directions using target-restricted rail injectivity. Retain halt215 and locally valid finish alternatives until the derived no-finish theorem applies. Record full independent review, six fresh bounded Lean replays and thirty-five standard-only axiom audits; leave complete row dynamics as the next composition.

Reuse core list lookup lemmas in annotated checker proofs

Adopt the list-library proposal across five Annotated modules, replacing seven repeated inductions by List.mem_of_getElem? and List.getElem?_of_mem. Remove40 lines and1553 bytes while retaining private wrapper signatures, names, parser/checker definitions and premises.

All five module builds, four direct clients and five existing focused checks pass Lean; executable controls and standard-axiom reports remain valid. ROOT reviewed every changed declaration. Update adoption and iteration records, bringing this batch to197 maintained Lean lines removed across20 modules.

Merge current main and reconcile proof-simplification adoption records

Merge immutable fetched9bd29079d5e1c6cc1c0bcaee6cb57d59b835cba9. Preserve the upstream packet consolidation and degree-certificate improvements together with this branch’s six checked proof-simplification commits.

Resolve the sole directory-rename/addition conflict by folding the per-packet adoption record into the new shared adoption table. Bind the three validated packet adoptions and the independently implemented coefficient specialization to their actual source/check results, preserve private wrapper signatures, and correct the recorded primitive-recursion standard-axiom footprints. Other queued upstream work retains its separate validation status.

Prove strict Wang-strip head containment and sharp actual trace bounds

Exclude entry into either seam wall using the actual active transition rail and the distinct literal wall bounds, including actions whose next state is halt. No time matching, no-finish or successor-row premise is added.

Prove generic write-before-move head and tape bounds, arbitrary independent finite margins and stationary halted extensions. Exercise sharp endpoints, both moves, zero-state machines and duplicate tape entries. Record complete source review, four fresh capped Lean passes, 22 standard-only axiom reports and independent row-encoding peer replay.

Prove actual Wang row evolution and construct its reverse step row

Force the exact write, target-bearing receiver and every unchanged pass cell from actual tile matching and the derived strip. Derive no-finish and head bounds instead of adding either as a premise; include entering halt with its original destination bit.

Construct an Allowed, horizontally matching whole-integer row for every operating configuration with north=current and south=actual step. Record four fresh capped Lean passes, 23 standard-only axiom audits and complete independent root source review. Periodic extraction and full converse remain separate obligations.

Merge origin/main proof simplifications and archive consolidation

Preserve the new actual Wang-machine step proofs while integrating upstream interface-preserving proof reductions, the kernel-checked degree-bound tactic and consolidated proposal/adoption records. Equation TeX/PDF, coefficient recipes and Lean pins are unchanged by incoming changes. Upstream validation is recorded in its review; this merge adds no full-library rebuild claim.

Reuse unconditional word bounds in weak-cap packing proofs

Replace duplicated positivity and low-mask derivations in the Split and Gap weak_cap_packing proofs with their existing unconditional_word_bounds tuples. Remove14 proof lines, preserving every scale, injectivity, target, nonnegativity and weak-cap hypothesis and all final upper bounds.

Both final modules and both existing focused axiom/example checks pass Lean with unchanged limits. Independent review checks the full helper contracts and changed packing proofs; record the validation scope in the iteration review.

Simplify support sums and predecessor powers in mask proofs

Remove20 lines across LowMaskCoding and MultiTargetCarry using Finset.filter_mem_eq_of_subset, injectivity-based coordinate simplification and Nat.sub_add_cancel for predecessor powers. Retain all definitions, statements, imports and mask/range/injectivity hypotheses.

Both rebuilt sources, two focused checks and five direct clients pass Lean; standard-axiom output and independent diff review pass. Record the current-source adoption and exact nine-command validation scope.

Share finite residual proofs across the circuit compilers

Introduce CompilerSupport for finite sums of squared residuals, their degree bounds and natural assignment transport. Reuse these facts in DAGQuartic, NaturalDAGQuartic and QuadraticRegisterSystem, removing33 lines and1612 bytes including the new36-line helper.

Preserve all existing theorem statements, topology/nonnegativity assumptions, circuit/expression data and witnesses. Four rebuilt modules, two clients, three focused compiler checks and the helper/API axiom audit pass Lean; eight rewritten public results retain their prior standard-axiom sets. ROOT and an independent peer reviewed the helper, changed proofs and acyclic import layering. Record adoption and this series’264-line cumulative reduction.

+import DiophantineConsistency.QuarticSyntax
+import Mathlib.Data.Sum.Basic
+
+/-! Shared finite-residual facts used by circuit compilers. -/
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CompilerSupport
+
+theorem eval_sumExpressions {σ : Type*} (es : List (Expr σ)) (v : σ → ℤ) :
+    (QuarticSyntax.sumExpressions es).eval v = (es.map (fun e => e.eval v)).sum := by
+  induction es <;> simp_all [QuarticSyntax.sumExpressions]
+
+theorem sumSquares_zero_iff {σ : Type*} {n : ℕ}
+    (es : Fin n → Expr σ) (v : σ → ℤ) :
+    (QuarticSyntax.sumExpressions (List.ofFn fun i => es i * es i)).eval v = 0 ↔
+      ∀ i, (es i).eval v = 0 := by
+  rw [eval_sumExpressions]
+  simp only [List.map_ofFn, Fin.sum_ofFn, Function.comp_apply, Expr.eval_mul]
+  simpa only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left] using
+    (Finset.sum_mul_self_eq_zero_iff (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
+      (fun i => (es i).eval v))

+/-!
+# The actual decimal machine's first blank-tape step
+
+The authenticated action-cache theorem supplies the first decoded action;
+the large decimal numeral is not reevaluated here. The resulting concrete
+configuration writes a one at zero and moves right into state one. This is
+the configuration represented by the initialization boundary components,
+not the all-blank configuration before the first machine transition.
+No tiling, machine-run extraction or consistency equivalence is assumed.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.DecimalMachineInitialization
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Transport the cached first action through the proved complete decoder
+binding; do not unfold or evaluate the715-digit decoder again. -/
+theorem first_action : DecimalMachine215.action 0 = (true, true, 1) := by
+  exact (WangTiles942.action_eq_decoder (0 : Fin 430)).symm.trans
+    WangTiles942.actual_first_action
+
+/-- The actual machine convention is write, then move right, then state1. -/
+theorem first_transition : DecimalMachine215.machine.transition (0 : Fin 215) false =
+    ({ write := true, move := Move.right, next := some (1 : Fin 215) } : Action 215) := by
+  change KDense215.act (DecimalMachine215.action 0) = _
+  rw [first_action]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Exact finite-support configuration after one step from the blank tape. -/
+def initialized : Config 215 where
+  state := some 1
+  head := 1
+  tape := [0]
+
+theorem step_initial : DecimalMachine215.machine.step (initial 215) = initialized := by
+  simp only [Machine.step, initial, startState, Tape.read, List.not_mem_nil, ite_false]
+  have hz : (⟨0, Nat.succ_pos 214⟩ : Fin 215) = 0 := by
+    apply Fin.ext
+    rfl
+  rw [hz, first_transition]
+  rfl
+
+theorem run_one : DecimalMachine215.machine.run 1 = initialized := by
+  exact step_initial
+
+@[simp] theorem initialized_state : initialized.state = some (1 : Fin 215) := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem initialized_head : initialized.head = (1 : ℤ) := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem initialized_tape : initialized.tape = [0] := rfl
+
+theorem initialized_not_halted : initialized.state ≠ none := by decide
+
+/-- The only written symbol is exactly the origin; all integer positions
+other than zero, including the new head position, still read blank. -/
+theorem initialized_read_true_iff (p : ℤ) : Tape.read initialized.tape p = true ↔ p = 0 := by
+  simp [initialized, Tape.read]
+
+theorem initialized_read_false_iff (p : ℤ) : Tape.read initialized.tape p = false ↔ p ≠ 0 := by
+  simp [initialized, Tape.read]
+
+theorem initialized_read_origin : Tape.read initialized.tape 0 = true := rfl
+
+theorem initialized_read_head : Tape.read initialized.tape initialized.head = false := rfl
+

+first blank-tape transition, without changing the machine or its clock. -/
+theorem runFrom_initialized (t : ℕ) :

+  have hh := DecimalMachine215.machine.run_add_eq_runFrom 1 t

+    cases t with

+        rw [runFrom_initialized]

+    rw [← runFrom_initialized]
+    exact ht

+  rw [WangTiles942.start_zero]

+theorem initialized_head_color : WangTiles942.headColor 1 0 = 4 := rfl

+theorem initializer_south : (WangTiles942.tile 928).south = WangTiles942.headColor 1 0 := by
+  rw [WangTiles942.initializer_928]

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.CommRing
+
+/-!
+# A syntactic total-degree bound tactic
+
+`total_degree_bound` proves goals `p.totalDegree ≤ n` for an explicit `MvPolynomial`
+expression `p` built from variables, constants, numerals, `+`, `-`, `*`, negation
+and natural powers. It reads the bound off the syntax tree: variables count one,
+constants zero, sums take the maximum and products add. Shared subterms are
+bounded once. The bound ignores cancellation, so a polynomial whose leading
+terms cancel needs a rewrite to a cancellation-free form first.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.TotalDegreeBound
+
+open MvPolynomial Lean Meta Elab Tactic
+
+variable {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+
+theorem add_le {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} {a b n : ℕ} (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ a)
+    (hq : q.totalDegree ≤ b) (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n) : (p + q).totalDegree ≤ n :=
+  (totalDegree_add p q).trans (max_le (hp.trans ha) (hq.trans hb))
+
+theorem sub_le {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} {a b n : ℕ} (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ a)
+    (hq : q.totalDegree ≤ b) (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n) : (p - q).totalDegree ≤ n :=
+  (totalDegree_sub p q).trans (max_le (hp.trans ha) (hq.trans hb))
+
+theorem mul_le {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} {a b n : ℕ} (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ a)
+    (hq : q.totalDegree ≤ b) (h : a + b ≤ n) : (p * q).totalDegree ≤ n :=
+  ((totalDegree_mul p q).trans (Nat.add_le_add hp hq)).trans h
+
+theorem pow_le {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {a n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ a)
+    (h : k * a ≤ n) : (p ^ k).totalDegree ≤ n :=
+  ((totalDegree_pow p k).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hp)).trans h
+
+theorem neg_le {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {a : ℕ} (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ a) :
+    (-p).totalDegree ≤ a := by rwa [totalDegree_neg]
+
+theorem X_le (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
+  have h := totalDegree_monomial_le (R := R) (Finsupp.single i 1) 1
+  rwa [Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl] at h
+
+theorem C_le (c : R) : (C c : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 0 := (totalDegree_C c).le
+
+theorem natCast_le (k : ℕ) : (k : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 0 := by
+  simpa only [map_natCast] using (totalDegree_C (σ := σ) (k : R)).le
+
+theorem ofNat_le (k : ℕ) [k.AtLeastTwo] :
+    (OfNat.ofNat k : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 0 := natCast_le k
+
+theorem zero_le' : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 0 := totalDegree_zero.le
+
+theorem one_le : (1 : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 0 := totalDegree_one.le
+
+private abbrev Cache := Std.HashMap Expr (Nat × Expr)
+
+/-- A proof of `a ≤ b` for closed natural-number terms, by `decide`. -/
+private def leProof (a b : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
+  mkDecideProof (← mkAppM ``LE.le #[a, b])
+
+/-- Returns `(n, h)` with `h : e.totalDegree ≤ n`. -/
+private partial def bound (e : Expr) : StateT Cache MetaM (Nat × Expr) := do
+  if let some r := (← get)[e]? then return r
+  let lit := mkNatLit
+  let r ← match e.getAppFnArgs with
+    | (``HAdd.hAdd, #[_, _, _, _, a, b]) | (``HSub.hSub, #[_, _, _, _, a, b]) => do
+        let (m, pa) ← bound a
+        let (k, pb) ← bound b
+        let n := max m k
+        let thm := if e.isAppOf ``HAdd.hAdd then ``add_le else ``sub_le
+        pure (n, ← mkAppM thm #[pa, pb, ← leProof (lit m) (lit n), ← leProof (lit k) (lit n)])
+    | (``HMul.hMul, #[_, _, _, _, a, b]) => do
+        let (m, pa) ← bound a
+        let (k, pb) ← bound b
+        pure (m + k, ← mkAppM ``mul_le
+          #[pa, pb, ← leProof (← mkAppM ``HAdd.hAdd #[lit m, lit k]) (lit (m + k))])
+    | (``Neg.neg, #[_, _, a]) => do
+        let (m, pa) ← bound a
+        pure (m, ← mkAppM ``neg_le #[pa])
+    | (``HPow.hPow, #[_, _, _, _, a, k]) => do
+        let some kv ← (evalNat k).run | throwError "total_degree_bound: exponent {k}"
+        let (m, pa) ← bound a
+        pure (kv * m, ← mkAppM ``pow_le
+          #[k, pa, ← leProof (← mkAppM ``HMul.hMul #[k, lit m]) (lit (kv * m))])
+    | _ => do
+        let ty ← instantiateMVars (← inferType e)
+        let .some (σ, R) := (match ty.getAppFnArgs with
+          | (``MvPolynomial, #[σ, R, _]) => some (σ, R) | _ => none)
+          | throwError "total_degree_bound: {e} is not an MvPolynomial"
+        let leaves : List (Nat × Name × Array (Option Expr)) :=
+          match e.getAppFnArgs with
+          | (``MvPolynomial.X, #[_, _, _, i]) => [(1, ``X_le, #[σ, R, none, i])]
+          | (``DFunLike.coe, #[_, _, _, _, f, c]) =>
+              if f.isAppOf ``MvPolynomial.C then [(0, ``C_le, #[σ, R, none, c])] else []
+          | (``OfNat.ofNat, #[_, k, _]) =>
+              [(0, ``ofNat_le, #[σ, R, none, k, none]), (0, ``zero_le', #[σ, R, none]),
+                (0, ``one_le, #[σ, R, none])]
+          | (``Nat.cast, #[_, _, k]) => [(0, ``natCast_le, #[σ, R, none, k])]
+          | _ => []
+        let found ← leaves.findSomeM? fun (n, thm, args) => do
+          try
+            let pf ← mkAppOptM thm args
+            let goal ← mkAppM ``LE.le #[← mkAppM ``MvPolynomial.totalDegree #[e], lit n]
+            if ← isDefEq (← inferType pf) goal then return some (n, pf) else return none
+          catch _ => return none
+        let some r := found | throwError "total_degree_bound: cannot bound {e}"
+        pure r
+  modify (·.insert e r)
+  return r
+
+/-- Proves `p.totalDegree ≤ n` from the syntax of `p`, as described in the module doc. -/
+elab "total_degree_bound" : tactic => liftMetaFinishingTactic fun g => do
+  let t ← instantiateMVars (← whnfR (← g.getType))
+  let some (_, lhs, rhs) := t.le? | throwError "total_degree_bound: goal is not `≤`"
+  let some n ← (evalNat rhs).run | throwError "total_degree_bound: bound {rhs} is not a numeral"
+  let ((m, pf), _) ← (bound lhs.appArg!).run {}
+  unless m ≤ n do throwError "total_degree_bound: syntactic bound {m} exceeds {n}"
+  g.assign (← mkAppM ``le_trans #[pf, ← leProof (mkNatLit m) rhs])
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.TotalDegreeBound

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineEncoding

+/-!
+# Actual decimal transitions and literal Wang-table actions
+
+The input index is `2*q+b`. The existing complete decoder/cache theorem
+binds its literal action to the actual machine transition. Target bounds
+come from the already proved actual direction-specific target sets, so
+the target215 is exactly the optional halt state and not an out-of-range
+operating state. No decimal numeral or full table is reevaluated here.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineAction
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC WangMachineEncoding
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The literal 430-action index of an operating state and read bit. -/
+def inputIndex (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) : Fin 430 :=
+  ⟨2 * q.val + b.toNat, by
+    have hq := q.isLt
+    have hb := bit_le_one b
+    omega⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem inputIndex_val (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val = 2 * q.val + b.toNat := rfl
+
+theorem inputIndex_div_two (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val / 2 = q.val := by
+  have hb := bit_le_one b
+  rw [inputIndex_val]
+  omega
+
+theorem inputIndex_mod_two (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val % 2 = b.toNat := by
+  have hb := bit_le_one b
+  rw [inputIndex_val]
+  omega
+
+/-- The transition tile's north color is the encoded operating head. -/
+theorem inputIndex_north (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val + 2 = WangTiles942.headColor q.val b.toNat := rfl
+
+theorem action_target_lt (j : Fin 430) : (WangTiles942.action j).2.2 < 216 := by
+  apply WangTiles942.target_bounds (WangTiles942.action j).2.1
+  exact List.mem_toFinset.mp (WangTiles942Language.action_target_mem j)
+
+/-- Valid numeric targets preserve their number under the actual optional
+state convention, including exactly the halting target215. -/
+theorem act_stateNumber (a : Bool × Bool × ℕ) (ha : a.2.2 < 216) :
+    stateNumber (KDense215.act a).next = a.2.2 := by
+  by_cases h : a.2.2 < 215
+  · simp [KDense215.act, h, stateNumber]
+  · have he : a.2.2 = 215 := by omega
+    simp [KDense215.act, stateNumber, he]
+
+theorem act_next_none_iff (a : Bool × Bool × ℕ) (ha : a.2.2 < 216) :
+    (KDense215.act a).next = none ↔ a.2.2 = 215 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hs := act_stateNumber a ha
+    rw [h, stateNumber_none] at hs
+    exact hs.symm
+  · intro h
+    apply stateNumber_injective
+    rw [act_stateNumber a ha, h, stateNumber_none]
+
+/-- This binds the literal cached action to the actual decimal machine. -/
+theorem transition_eq_cached (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b =
+      KDense215.act (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)) := by
+  change KDense215.act (DecimalMachine215.action (2 * q.val + if b then 1 else 0)) = _
+  have hi : 2 * q.val + (if b then 1 else 0) = (inputIndex q b).val := by
+    cases b <;> rfl
+  rw [hi]
+  exact congrArg KDense215.act (WangTiles942.action_eq_decoder (inputIndex q b)).symm
+
+theorem transition_write (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).write =
+      (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).1 := by
+  rw [transition_eq_cached]
+  rfl
+
+theorem transition_move (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).move =
+      if (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.1 then Move.right else Move.left := by
+  rw [transition_eq_cached]
+  rfl
+
+theorem transition_moved_head (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) (p : ℤ) :
+    (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).move.apply p =
+      if (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.1 then p + 1 else p - 1 := by
+  rw [transition_move]
+  cases (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.1 <;> rfl
+
+theorem transition_stateNumber (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    stateNumber (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).next =
+      (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.2 := by
+  rw [transition_eq_cached]
+  exact act_stateNumber _ (action_target_lt _)
+
+theorem transition_next_none_iff (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).next = none ↔
+      (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.2 = 215 := by
+  rw [transition_eq_cached]
+  exact act_next_none_iff _ (action_target_lt _)
+
+/-- The receiving tile's numeric target gives precisely the encoded actual
+next head, including halting heads432/433. Its read bit is unrestricted. -/
+theorem transition_headColor (q : Fin 215) (b c : Bool) :
+    headColor (DecimalMachine215.machine.transition q b).next c =
+      WangTiles942.headColor (WangTiles942.action (inputIndex q b)).2.2 c.toNat := by
+  unfold headColor
+  rw [transition_stateNumber]

+import DiophantineConsistency.DecimalMachineInitialization
+
+/-!
+# Literal vertical colors of an actual machine configuration
+
+Plain tape cells carry 0 or 1. The unique head carries `2*q+b+2`,
+where operating states have q < 215 and the halted state has q = 215.
+An action entering halt still writes and moves before this encoding is
+applied; its final head has color 432 or 433 at the moved position.
+This module defines no tiling or machine-run correspondence premise.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineEncoding
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The literal table's state number, including its separate halt state. -/
+def stateNumber : Option (Fin 215) → ℕ
+  | none => 215
+  | some q => q.val
+
+@[simp] theorem stateNumber_none : stateNumber none = 215 := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem stateNumber_some (q : Fin 215) : stateNumber (some q) = q.val := rfl
+
+theorem stateNumber_le (s : Option (Fin 215)) : stateNumber s ≤ 215 := by
+  cases s with
+  | none => exact Nat.le_refl _
+  | some q => exact Nat.le_of_lt q.isLt
+
+theorem stateNumber_injective : Function.Injective stateNumber := by
+  intro s t h
+  cases s with
+  | none =>
+      cases t with
+      | none => rfl
+      | some q =>
+          simp only [stateNumber] at h
+          have hq := q.isLt
+          omega
+  | some p =>
+      cases t with
+      | none =>
+          simp only [stateNumber] at h
+          have hp := p.isLt
+          omega
+      | some q =>
+          exact congrArg some (Fin.ext h)
+
+theorem bit_le_one (b : Bool) : b.toNat ≤ 1 := by cases b <;> decide
+
+/-- Head colors use precisely the same constructor as the literal table. -/
+def headColor (s : Option (Fin 215)) (b : Bool) : ℕ :=
+  WangTiles942.headColor (stateNumber s) b.toNat
+
+theorem operating_head_color (q : Fin 215) (b : Bool) :
+    headColor (some q) b = WangTiles942.headColor q.val b.toNat := rfl
+
+theorem halted_head_color (b : Bool) : headColor none b = 432 + b.toNat := by
+  simp [headColor, stateNumber, WangTiles942.headColor]
+  omega
+
+theorem headColor_bounds (s : Option (Fin 215)) (b : Bool) :
+    2 ≤ headColor s b ∧ headColor s b ≤ 433 := by
+  have hs := stateNumber_le s
+  have hb := bit_le_one b
+  unfold headColor WangTiles942.headColor
+  omega
+
+theorem headColor_injective {s t : Option (Fin 215)} {b c : Bool} :
+    headColor s b = headColor t c ↔ s = t ∧ b = c := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hb := bit_le_one b
+    have hc := bit_le_one c
+    unfold headColor WangTiles942.headColor at h
+    have hs : stateNumber s = stateNumber t := by omega
+    have he : b.toNat = c.toNat := by omega
+    refine ⟨stateNumber_injective hs, ?_⟩
+    cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all
+  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+    rfl
+
+/-- Encode the actual tape, state and head of a configuration. -/
+def color (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) : ℕ :=
+  if x = cfg.head then headColor cfg.state (Tape.read cfg.tape x)
+  else (Tape.read cfg.tape x).toNat
+
+theorem color_at_head (cfg : Config 215) :
+    color cfg cfg.head = headColor cfg.state (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head) := by
+  simp [color]
+
+theorem color_of_ne_head (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) (h : x ≠ cfg.head) :
+    color cfg x = (Tape.read cfg.tape x).toNat := by
+  simp only [color, if_neg h]
+
+theorem plain_color_le_one (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) (h : x ≠ cfg.head) :
+    color cfg x ≤ 1 := by
+  rw [color_of_ne_head cfg x h]
+  exact bit_le_one _
+
+theorem color_le_433 (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) : color cfg x ≤ 433 := by
+  by_cases h : x = cfg.head
+  · subst x
+    rw [color_at_head]
+    exact (headColor_bounds _ _).2
+  · have hp := plain_color_le_one cfg x h
+    omega
+
+/-- The color itself singles out the configuration's unique head. -/
+theorem head_iff (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) : 2 ≤ color cfg x ↔ x = cfg.head := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    by_contra hn
+    have hp := plain_color_le_one cfg x hn
+    omega
+  · rintro rfl
+    rw [color_at_head]
+    exact (headColor_bounds _ _).1
+
+/-- Even an action whose next state is `none` first writes and moves.
+This records the underlying operational convention, without a color shortcut. -/
+theorem step_enter_halt (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hh : (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).next = none) :
+    M.step cfg =
+      { state := none,
+        head := (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).move.apply cfg.head,
+        tape := Tape.write cfg.tape cfg.head
+          (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).write } := by
+  simp only [Machine.step, hq, hh]
+
+theorem step_enter_halt_color (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hh : (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).next = none) :
+    color (M.step cfg)
+        ((M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).move.apply cfg.head) =
+      432 + (Tape.read
+        (Tape.write cfg.tape cfg.head (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).write)
+        ((M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).move.apply cfg.head)).toNat := by
+  rw [step_enter_halt M cfg q hq hh]
+  exact (color_at_head _).trans (halted_head_color _)
+
+theorem initialized_color_zero : color DecimalMachineInitialization.initialized 0 = 1 := rfl
+
+theorem initialized_color_one : color DecimalMachineInitialization.initialized 1 = 4 := rfl
+
+theorem initialized_color_other (x : ℤ) (h0 : x ≠ 0) (h1 : x ≠ 1) :
+    color DecimalMachineInitialization.initialized x = 0 := by
+  rw [color_of_ne_head _ x h1,
+    (DecimalMachineInitialization.initialized_read_false_iff x).mpr h0]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The actual boundary configuration is exactly a written origin and an
+adjacent operating state1 reading0, with plain blank cells elsewhere. -/
+theorem initialized_color (x : ℤ) :
+    color DecimalMachineInitialization.initialized x =
+      if x = 0 then 1 else if x = 1 then 4 else 0 := by
+  by_cases h0 : x = 0
+  · subst x
+    exact initialized_color_zero
+  · by_cases h1 : x = 1
+    · subst x
+      exact initialized_color_one
+    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
+      exact initialized_color_other x h0 h1
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineEncoding

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineEncoding
+
+/-!
+# Actual operational step in vertical colors
+
+A live-state action writes at the old head and moves exactly one cell.
+The destination therefore reads its old tape bit. Its new head color uses
+the action's actual optional next state, including entry into halt.
+No tile-row, run-calibration, or consistency premise is used.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineStep
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver WangMachineEncoding
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+theorem moved_head_left_or_right (m : Move) (p : ℤ) :
+    m.apply p = p - 1 ∨ m.apply p = p + 1 := by
+  cases m with
+  | left => exact Or.inl rfl
+  | right => exact Or.inr rfl
+
+theorem moved_head_ne (m : Move) (p : ℤ) : m.apply p ≠ p := by
+  rcases moved_head_left_or_right m p with h | h <;> omega
+
+/-- Writing at the old head cannot change the bit at the moved head. -/
+theorem read_written_at_moved (tape : Tape) (p : ℤ) (a : Action 215) :
+    Tape.read (Tape.write tape p a.write) (a.move.apply p) =
+      Tape.read tape (a.move.apply p) :=
+  Tape.read_write_of_ne tape (moved_head_ne a.move p) a.write
+
+/-- This is the actual record returned by `Machine.step` at a live state.
+No assumption on `next` is made. -/
+theorem step_eq (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    M.step cfg =
+      let a := M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)
+      { state := a.next, head := a.move.apply cfg.head,
+        tape := Tape.write cfg.tape cfg.head a.write } := by
+  simp only [Machine.step, hq]
+
+theorem step_head_left_or_right (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    (M.step cfg).head = cfg.head - 1 ∨ (M.step cfg).head = cfg.head + 1 := by
+  rw [step_eq M cfg q hq]
+  exact moved_head_left_or_right _ _
+
+theorem step_head_ne (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) : (M.step cfg).head ≠ cfg.head := by
+  rcases step_head_left_or_right M cfg q hq with h | h <;> omega
+
+theorem step_read_at_new_head (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    Tape.read (M.step cfg).tape (M.step cfg).head =
+      Tape.read cfg.tape (M.step cfg).head := by
+  rw [step_eq M cfg q hq]
+  exact read_written_at_moved _ _ _
+
+/-- The exact three-way color update for an arbitrary action record. -/
+theorem color_action (cfg : Config 215) (a : Action 215) (x : ℤ) :
+    color
+      ({ state := a.next
+         head := a.move.apply cfg.head
+         tape := Tape.write cfg.tape cfg.head a.write } : Config 215) x =
+      if x = a.move.apply cfg.head then headColor a.next (Tape.read cfg.tape x)
+      else if x = cfg.head then a.write.toNat else color cfg x := by
+  by_cases hn : x = a.move.apply cfg.head
+  · subst x
+    simp [color, read_written_at_moved]
+  · by_cases ho : x = cfg.head
+    · subst x
+      simp [color, hn]
+    · simp only [color, if_neg hn, if_neg ho]
+      rw [Tape.read_write_of_ne cfg.tape ho a.write]
+
+/-- The complete actual machine-step formula. The head branch uses
+`a.next` even when it is `none`; writing and movement have already occurred. -/
+theorem color_step (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) (x : ℤ) :
+    let a := M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)
+    color (M.step cfg) x =
+      if x = a.move.apply cfg.head then headColor a.next (Tape.read cfg.tape x)
+      else if x = cfg.head then a.write.toNat else color cfg x := by
+  dsimp only
+  rw [step_eq M cfg q hq]
+  exact color_action cfg _ x
+
+theorem color_step_new_head (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    let a := M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)
+    color (M.step cfg) (a.move.apply cfg.head) =
+      headColor a.next (Tape.read cfg.tape (a.move.apply cfg.head)) := by
+  dsimp only
+  rw [color_step M cfg q hq]
+  simp
+
+theorem color_step_old_head (M : Machine 215) (cfg : Config 215) (q : Fin 215)
+    (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    color (M.step cfg) cfg.head =
+      (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).write.toNat := by
+  rw [color_step M cfg q hq]

+    (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hh : (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).next = none) :

+      Tape.read tape (a.move.apply p) := read_written_at_moved tape p a

+    (x : ℤ) :

+example : color (rightWriteHalt.step sample) 0 = 1 := rfl
+example : color (rightWriteHalt.step sample) (-1) = 1 := rfl

+import BusyBeaver.Core
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Ring.Int
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Abs
+
+/-!
+# Explicit finite bounds for actual blank machine traces
+
+The bounds follow directly from the repository's write-before-move operational
+semantics. They include entry into halt and stationary halted steps. No tape
+normalization, tiling, or run-calibration hypothesis is used.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineTraceBounds
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Every actual step moves by at most one, including a stationary halted step. -/
+theorem step_head_bounds {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (cfg : Config n) :
+    cfg.head - 1 ≤ (M.step cfg).head ∧ (M.step cfg).head ≤ cfg.head + 1 := by
+  cases hs : cfg.state with
+  | none => simp only [Machine.step, hs]; omega
+  | some q =>
+      simp only [Machine.step, hs]
+      cases hm : (M.transition q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)).move <;>
+        simp only [Move.apply] <;> omega
+
+/-- A step changes no tape read away from its old head, regardless of its next state. -/
+theorem step_read_of_ne {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (cfg : Config n)
+    (x : ℤ) (hx : x ≠ cfg.head) :
+    Tape.read (M.step cfg).tape x = Tape.read cfg.tape x := by
+  cases hs : cfg.state with
+  | none => simp only [Machine.step, hs]
+  | some q =>
+      simp only [Machine.step, hs]
+      exact Tape.read_write_of_ne cfg.tape hx _
+
+/-- Displacement bounds from an arbitrary initial configuration. -/
+theorem runFrom_head_bounds {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (cfg : Config n) (t : ℕ) :
+    cfg.head - (t : ℤ) ≤ (M.runFrom cfg t).head ∧
+      (M.runFrom cfg t).head ≤ cfg.head + (t : ℤ) := by
+  induction t with
+  | zero => simp only [Machine.runFrom, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, add_zero, le_refl, and_self]
+  | succ t ih =>
+      have hs := step_head_bounds M (M.runFrom cfg t)
+      rw [Machine.runFrom_succ]
+      push_cast
+      omega
+
+/-- At the inclusive outer boundary, no write has yet occurred: the last
+write used the head before the final move. This needs no support hypothesis. -/
+theorem runFrom_read_outside {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (cfg : Config n)
+    (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ)
+    (hx : x ≤ cfg.head - (t : ℤ) ∨ cfg.head + (t : ℤ) ≤ x) :
+    Tape.read (M.runFrom cfg t).tape x = Tape.read cfg.tape x := by
+  induction t with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ t ih =>
+      have hh := runFrom_head_bounds M cfg t
+      have hne : x ≠ (M.runFrom cfg t).head := by omega
+      have hold : x ≤ cfg.head - (t : ℤ) ∨ cfg.head + (t : ℤ) ≤ x := by omega
+      rw [Machine.runFrom_succ, step_read_of_ne M _ x hne]
+      exact ih hold
+
+theorem run_eq_runFrom_initial {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (t : ℕ) :
+    M.run t = M.runFrom (initial n) t := by
+  simpa only [zero_add, Machine.run] using M.run_add_eq_runFrom 0 t
+
+/-- The actual blank-run head is in the closed interval [-t,t]. -/
+theorem run_head_bounds {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (t : ℕ) :
+    -(t : ℤ) ≤ (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head ≤ (t : ℤ) := by
+  rw [run_eq_runFrom_initial]
+  simpa only [initial, zero_sub, zero_add] using runFrom_head_bounds M (initial n) t
+
+theorem run_head_abs_le {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (t : ℕ) :
+    |(M.run t).head| ≤ (t : ℤ) := abs_le.mpr (run_head_bounds M t)
+
+/-- Sharp uniform blank-tape support: every position outside (-t,t) reads false. -/
+theorem run_read_outside {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ)
+    (hx : x ≤ -(t : ℤ) ∨ (t : ℤ) ≤ x) : Tape.read (M.run t).tape x = false := by
+  rw [run_eq_runFrom_initial]
+  have he := runFrom_read_outside M (initial n) t x (by
+    simpa only [initial, zero_sub, zero_add] using hx)
+  simpa only [initial, Tape.read, List.not_mem_nil, ↓reduceIte] using he
+
+theorem run_read_of_abs_ge {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ)
+    (hx : (t : ℤ) ≤ |x|) : Tape.read (M.run t).tape x = false := by
+  apply run_read_outside M t x
+  by_cases h : 0 ≤ x
+  · rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at hx
+    exact Or.inr hx
+  · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h)] at hx
+    exact Or.inl (by omega)
+
+/-- Independent left and right margins may be enlarged arbitrarily. -/
+theorem finite_trace_box {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T L R : ℕ)
+    (hL : T < L) (hR : T < R) :
+    ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
+      -(L : ℤ) < (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head < (R : ℤ) ∧
+      ∀ x : ℤ, x ≤ -(L : ℤ) ∨ (R : ℤ) ≤ x → Tape.read (M.run t).tape x = false := by
+  intro t ht
+  have hh := run_head_bounds M t
+  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
+  intro x hx
+  apply run_read_outside M t x
+  omega
+
+/-- The concrete walls ±(T+1) enclose every head up to T and remain blank. -/
+theorem finite_trace_margins {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T : ℕ) :
+    ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
+      -((T : ℤ)+1) < (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head < (T : ℤ)+1 ∧
+      Tape.read (M.run t).tape (-((T : ℤ)+1)) = false ∧
+      Tape.read (M.run t).tape ((T : ℤ)+1) = false := by
+  intro t ht
+  obtain ⟨hl,hr,hblank⟩ := finite_trace_box M T (T+1) (T+1) (by omega) (by omega) t ht
+  refine ⟨by simpa using hl, by simpa using hr, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact hblank _ (Or.inl (by omega))
+  · exact hblank _ (Or.inr (by omega))
+
+/-- Actual halted configurations remain fixed; no active-step premise is needed. -/
+theorem run_eq_of_halted {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T : ℕ)
+    (hh : (M.run T).state = none) (t : ℕ) (ht : T ≤ t) : M.run t = M.run T := by
+  have he : t = T + (t-T) := by omega
+  rw [he, Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom]
+  exact M.runFrom_of_halted (M.run T) hh (t-T)
+
+/-- If the trace has halted by T, the same independently chosen margins work
+at every later time too. The halt hypothesis is a conclusion to reuse, not an axiom. -/
+theorem halted_trace_box {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T L R : ℕ)
+    (hh : (M.run T).state = none) (hL : T < L) (hR : T < R) :
+    ∀ t : ℕ, -(L : ℤ) < (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head < (R : ℤ) ∧
+      ∀ x : ℤ, x ≤ -(L : ℤ) ∨ (R : ℤ) ≤ x → Tape.read (M.run t).tape x = false := by
+  intro t
+  by_cases ht : t ≤ T
+  · exact finite_trace_box M T L R hL hR t ht
+  · rw [run_eq_of_halted M T hh t (by omega)]
+    exact finite_trace_box M T L R hL hR T (Nat.le_refl T)
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineTraceBounds

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineTraceBounds
+
+/-! Sharp endpoint, halt-entry, stationary-halt, and unnormalized-tape checks. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineTraceBoundsChecks
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver WangMachineTraceBounds
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+private def enterHalt (m : Move) : Machine 1 where
+  transition _ _ := ⟨true,m,none⟩
+
+-- Entering halt still writes at 0 and moves to 1, whose old bit remains blank.
+example : ((enterHalt .right).run 1).state = none ∧
+    ((enterHalt .right).run 1).head = 1 ∧
+    Tape.read ((enterHalt .right).run 1).tape 0 = true ∧
+    Tape.read ((enterHalt .right).run 1).tape 1 = false := by decide +kernel
+
+-- The opposite boundary also needs the inclusive head bound.
+example : ((enterHalt .left).run 1).state = none ∧
+    ((enterHalt .left).run 1).head = -1 ∧
+    Tape.read ((enterHalt .left).run 1).tape 0 = true ∧
+    Tape.read ((enterHalt .left).run 1).tape (-1) = false := by decide +kernel
+
+-- Later halted steps neither move the head nor clear the written bit.
+example (m : Move) (t : ℕ) : (enterHalt m).run (1+t) = (enterHalt m).run 1 := by
+  apply run_eq_of_halted (enterHalt m) 1
+  · cases m <;> rfl
+  · omega
+
+-- The tape bound cannot uniformly be tightened from |x|≥t to |x|≥t−1.
+example : ¬ (∀ x : ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ≤ |x| →
+    Tape.read ((enterHalt .right).run 1).tape x = false) := by
+  intro h
+  have hc := h 0 (by decide)
+  have hv : Tape.read ((enterHalt .right).run 1).tape 0 = true := by decide +kernel
+  rw [hv] at hc
+  contradiction
+
+-- No Nodup/support normalization is required for arbitrary initial tape reads.
+example (M : Machine 1) :
+    Tape.read (M.runFrom ⟨some (0 : Fin 1),7,[100,100]⟩ 10).tape 100 = true := by
+  rw [runFrom_read_outside M _ 10 100 (by right; decide)]
+  decide
+
+-- A zero-state machine is already halted at the blank initial configuration.
+example (M : Machine 0) (t : ℕ) : M.run t = initial 0 := by
+  rw [run_eq_runFrom_initial]
+  exact M.runFrom_of_halted (initial 0) rfl t
+
+-- The time-zero sharp support bound includes the origin itself.
+example {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (x : ℤ) : Tape.read (M.run 0).tape x = false :=
+  run_read_of_abs_ge M 0 x (abs_nonneg x)
+
+-- Left and right widths need not be equal, minimal, or related by divisibility.
+example {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) :
+    -((T : ℤ)+2) < (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head < (T : ℤ)+9 ∧
+    ∀ x : ℤ, x ≤ -((T : ℤ)+2) ∨ (T : ℤ)+9 ≤ x →
+      Tape.read (M.run t).tape x = false := by
+  simpa using finite_trace_box M T (T+2) (T+9) (by omega) (by omega) t ht
+
+-- A finite halt time yields the same blank walls for arbitrary later times.
+example {n : ℕ} (M : Machine n) (T : ℕ) (hh : (M.run T).state = none) (t : ℕ) :
+    -((T : ℤ)+1) < (M.run t).head ∧ (M.run t).head < (T : ℤ)+1 := by
+  obtain ⟨hl,hr,_⟩ := halted_trace_box M T (T+1) (T+1) hh (by omega) (by omega) t
+  exact ⟨by simpa using hl,by simpa using hr⟩
+

+#print axioms runFrom_read_outside
+#print axioms run_eq_runFrom_initial
+#print axioms run_head_bounds
+#print axioms run_head_abs_le
+#print axioms run_read_outside

+#print axioms finite_trace_box
+#print axioms finite_trace_margins
+#print axioms run_eq_of_halted
+#print axioms halted_trace_box
+

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942OperatingRow
+import DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineAction
+import DiophantineConsistency.WangMachineStep
+
+/-!
+# The actual stepped head remains strictly inside the strip
+
+A transition's active rail has color at least6. The right wall's west
+color is at most4 and the left wall's east color is at most2. Actual
+horizontal matching therefore prevents either move from entering a wall.
+The proof uses no absence-of-finish or time-matching premise.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942HeadBounds
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942RowEncoding
+  WangTiles942StripGeometry WangTiles942OperatingRow
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The finite-bit tile index and Boolean machine index are the same. -/
+theorem inputIndex_eq (q : Fin 215) (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) :
+    WangTiles942InputLanguage.inputIndex q (symbol cfg x) =
+      WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape x) := by
+  apply Fin.ext
+  rfl
+
+theorem head_transition {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {l r t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ)) (h : RowEncodes T l r t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    T cfg.head t =
+      (transitionRow (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2 := by
+  rw [operating_head_tile hA h q hq, inputIndex_eq]
+
+theorem right_active_edge {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {l r t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ)) (h : RowEncodes T l r t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hd : (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1 = true) :
+    6 ≤ (T cfg.head t).east := by
+  rw [head_transition hA h q hq]
+  have hr := (valid_rail_range (action_target_mem
+    (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)))).1
+  simp only [transitionRow, hd, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.one_mul] at *
+  exact hr
+
+theorem left_active_edge {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {l r t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ)) (h : RowEncodes T l r t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hd : (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1 = false) :
+    6 ≤ (T cfg.head t).west := by
+  rw [head_transition hA h q hq]
+  have hr := (valid_rail_range (action_target_mem
+    (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head)))).1
+  simp only [transitionRow, hd, Bool.toNat_false, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.one_mul] at *
+  exact hr
+
+theorem left_wall_east_le_two {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ}
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R) (t : ℤ) : (T (-(L : ℤ)) t).east ≤ 2 := by
+  obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := hs.left_wall t
+  rw [h]
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  change b.val ≤ 2
+  omega
+
+theorem right_wall_west_le_four {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ}
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R) (t : ℤ) : (T (R : ℤ) t).west ≤ 4 := by
+  obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := hs.right_wall t
+  rw [h]
+  have ha := a.isLt
+  change a.val^2 ≤ 4
+  have hc : a.val = 0 ∨ a.val = 1 ∨ a.val = 2 := by omega
+  rcases hc with he | he | he <;> rw [he] <;> decide
+
+theorem right_move_not_wall {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} {t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ))
+    (hH : ∀ x τ, (T (x+1) τ).west = (T x τ).east)
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R)
+    (h : RowEncodes T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hd : (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1 = true) :
+    cfg.head + 1 ≠ (R : ℤ) := by
+  intro he
+  have ha := right_active_edge hA h q hq hd
+  have hw := right_wall_west_le_four hs t
+  have hm := hH cfg.head t
+  rw [he] at hm
+  rw [hm] at hw
+  omega
+
+theorem left_move_not_wall {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} {t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ))
+    (hH : ∀ x τ, (T (x+1) τ).west = (T x τ).east)
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R)
+    (h : RowEncodes T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (hd : (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1 = false) :
+    cfg.head - 1 ≠ -(L : ℤ) := by
+  intro he
+  have ha := left_active_edge hA h q hq hd
+  have hw := left_wall_east_le_two hs t
+  have hm := hH (cfg.head-1) t
+  rw [sub_add_cancel, he] at hm
+  rw [← hm] at hw
+  omega
+
+/-- The actual successor head, including a successor entering halt,
+stays strictly between the existing persistent walls. -/
+theorem next_head_inside {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} {t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ))
+    (hH : ∀ x τ, (T (x+1) τ).west = (T x τ).east)
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R)
+    (h : RowEncodes T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    -(L : ℤ) < (DecimalMachine215.machine.step cfg).head ∧
+      (DecimalMachine215.machine.step cfg).head < (R : ℤ) := by
+  have hm : (DecimalMachine215.machine.step cfg).head =
+      if (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1
+      then cfg.head + 1 else cfg.head - 1 := by
+    rw [WangMachineStep.step_eq _ cfg q hq]
+    exact WangMachineAction.transition_moved_head _ _ _
+  have hl := h.head_left
+  have hr := h.head_right
+  cases hd : (action (WangMachineAction.inputIndex q (Tape.read cfg.tape cfg.head))).2.1 with
+  | false =>
+      have hn := left_move_not_wall hA hH hs h q hq hd
+      simp only [hd, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hm
+      omega
+  | true =>
+      have hn := right_move_not_wall hA hH hs h q hq hd
+      simp only [hd, if_true] at hm
+      omega
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942HeadBounds

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Periodic

+/-!
+# A finite initialization strip around Start in a periodic horizontal row
+
+The two first departures from the respective initializer tails must be
+seams. Horizontal periodicity supplies finite departure witnesses using
+Start on the left and the head initializer on the right. No unique Start,
+time evolution, machine run, or rectangular tiling premise is used.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942InitialStrip
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942InitialHorizontal
+  WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Exact wall tuples and every tile of the finite initial segment. -/
+structure InitialStrip (T : ℤ → Tile) (N L R : ℕ) : Prop where
+  left_pos : 0 < L
+  left_le : L ≤ N
+  right_min : 2 ≤ R
+  right_le : R ≤ N+1
+  start_at_zero : T 0 = start
+  head_at_one : T 1 = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩
+  left_wall : ∃ a : Fin 3, T (-(L : ℤ)) = ⟨a.val^2,437,2,437⟩
+  right_wall : ∃ b : Fin 3, T (R : ℤ) = ⟨4,437,b.val,437⟩
+  left_inside : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j < L → T (-(j : ℤ)) = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩
+  right_inside : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → j < R → T (j : ℤ) = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩
+
+theorem head_after_start (T : ℤ → Tile) (hallowed : ∀ x, Allowed (T x))
+    (hH : ∀ x, (T (x+1)).west = (T x).east) (hstart : T 0 = start) :
+    T 1 = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩ := by
+  apply (west_3_iff_initHead (hallowed 1)).mp
+  have hh := hH 0
+  simpa only [zero_add, hstart, start] using hh
+
+/-- First non-initLeft to the left. Periodic Start supplies a witness byN. -/
+theorem left_wall_exists (T : ℤ → Tile) (hallowed : ∀ x, Allowed (T x))
+    (hH : ∀ x, (T (x+1)).west = (T x).east)
+    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hperiod : Function.Periodic T (N : ℤ))
+    (hstart : T 0 = start) :
+    ∃ L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ L ≤ N ∧
+      (∃ a : Fin 3, T (-(L : ℤ)) = ⟨a.val^2,437,2,437⟩) ∧
+      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j < L → T (-(j : ℤ)) = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ := by
+  classical
+  have hminus : T (-(N : ℤ)) = start := by
+    have hh := hperiod (-(N : ℤ))
+    rw [neg_add_cancel, hstart] at hh
+    exact hh.symm
+  have hend : T (-(N : ℤ)) ≠ (⟨2,434,2,0⟩ : Tile) := by rw [hminus]; decide
+  have hex : ∃ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j ∧ T (-(j : ℤ)) ≠ (⟨2,434,2,0⟩ : Tile) :=
+    ⟨N, hN, hend⟩
+  let L := Nat.find hex
+  have hL : 1 ≤ L ∧ T (-(L : ℤ)) ≠ (⟨2,434,2,0⟩ : Tile) := Nat.find_spec hex
+  have hLN : L ≤ N := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hN,hend⟩
+  have hinside (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjl : j < L) :
+      T (-(j : ℤ)) = (⟨2,434,2,0⟩ : Tile) := by
+    by_contra hnot
+    have hh : L ≤ j := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hj,hnot⟩
+    omega
+  have hright : (T (-(L : ℤ)+1)).west = 2 := by
+    by_cases he : L = 1
+    · rw [he]
+      norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, neg_add_cancel]
+      rw [hstart]
+      rfl
+    · have hi := hinside (L-1) (by omega) (by omega)
+      have heq : -((L-1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = -(L : ℤ)+1 := by omega
+      rw [heq] at hi
+      rw [hi]
+  have heast : (T (-(L : ℤ))).east = 2 := (hH (-(L : ℤ))).symm.trans hright
+  rcases (east_2_iff_initLeft_or_seam (hallowed (-(L : ℤ)))).mp heast with hl | hs
+  · exact False.elim (hL.2 hl)
+  · exact ⟨L, hL.1, hLN, hs, hinside⟩
+
+/-- First non-initRight after the head. Periodic head supplies a witness byN+1. -/
+theorem right_wall_exists (T : ℤ → Tile) (hallowed : ∀ x, Allowed (T x))
+    (hH : ∀ x, (T (x+1)).west = (T x).east)
+    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hperiod : Function.Periodic T (N : ℤ))
+    (hhead : T 1 = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩) :
+    ∃ R : ℕ, 2 ≤ R ∧ R ≤ N+1 ∧
+      (∃ b : Fin 3, T (R : ℤ) = ⟨4,437,b.val,437⟩) ∧
+      ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → j < R → T (j : ℤ) = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩ := by
+  classical
+  have hplus : T ((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (⟨3,436,4,4⟩ : Tile) := by
+    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_comm]
+    exact (hperiod 1).trans hhead
+  have hend : T ((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ (⟨4,436,4,0⟩ : Tile) := by rw [hplus]; decide
+  have hex : ∃ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j ∧ T (j : ℤ) ≠ (⟨4,436,4,0⟩ : Tile) :=
+    ⟨N+1, by omega, hend⟩
+  let R := Nat.find hex
+  have hR : 2 ≤ R ∧ T (R : ℤ) ≠ (⟨4,436,4,0⟩ : Tile) := Nat.find_spec hex
+  have hRN : R ≤ N+1 := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨by omega,hend⟩
+  have hinside (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hjr : j < R) :
+      T (j : ℤ) = (⟨4,436,4,0⟩ : Tile) := by
+    by_contra hnot
+    have hh : R ≤ j := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hj,hnot⟩
+    omega
+  have hleft : (T ((R : ℤ)-1)).east = 4 := by
+    by_cases he : R = 2
+    · rw [he]
+      norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.reduceSub]
+      rw [hhead]
+    · have hi := hinside (R-1) (by omega) (by omega)
+      have heq : ((R-1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (R : ℤ)-1 := by omega
+      rw [heq] at hi
+      rw [hi]
+  have hwest : (T (R : ℤ)).west = 4 := by
+    have hh := hH ((R : ℤ)-1)
+    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hh
+    exact hh.trans hleft
+  rcases (west_4_iff_initRight_or_seam (hallowed (R : ℤ))).mp hwest with hr | hs
+  · exact False.elim (hR.2 hr)
+  · exact ⟨R, hR.1, hRN, hs, hinside⟩
+
+/-- A horizontally periodic allowed row containing Start has exact finite
+seam walls and a complete blank-initialization segment between them. -/
+theorem periodic_initial_strip (T : ℤ → Tile) (hallowed : ∀ x, Allowed (T x))
+    (hH : ∀ x, (T (x+1)).west = (T x).east)
+    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hperiod : Function.Periodic T (N : ℤ))
+    (hstart : T 0 = start) : ∃ L R : ℕ, InitialStrip T N L R := by
+  have hhead := head_after_start T hallowed hH hstart
+  obtain ⟨L,hL,hLN,hwallL,hinsideL⟩ := left_wall_exists T hallowed hH N hN hperiod hstart
+  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRN,hwallR,hinsideR⟩ := right_wall_exists T hallowed hH N hN hperiod hhead
+  exact ⟨L,R,hL,hLN,hR,hRN,hstart,hhead,hwallL,hwallR,hinsideL,hinsideR⟩
+
+theorem InitialStrip.wall_north {T : ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} (h : InitialStrip T N L R) :
+    (T (-(L : ℤ))).north = 437 ∧ (T (R : ℤ)).north = 437 := by
+  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := h.left_wall
+  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := h.right_wall
+  rw [ha,hb]
+  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
+
+/-- Specialization to the actual signed plane row uses only its marked word. -/
+theorem marked_initial_strip {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {s : ℤ} {a : ZMod N → Fin 942}
+    (h : MarkedWord N s a) :
+    ∃ L R : ℕ, InitialStrip (fun x => plane N s a x 0) N L R := by
+  apply periodic_initial_strip (fun x => plane N s a x 0)
+    (fun x => plane_allowed N s a x 0) (fun x => plane_east_matching h x 0)
+    N (NeZero.pos N) (fun x => plane_horizontal_period N s a x 0)
+  exact plane_start h
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942InitialStrip

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Boundary

+/-!
+# Exact local input grammar of the actual 942 Wang tiles
+
+An operating head input selects exactly its indexed transition. Halt
+inputs admit pass and finish, and plain inputs admit pass, finish, or a
+receive tile with an actual directional target. These are finite-language
+statements, not machine-step or unique-head semantics for a whole row.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942InputLanguage
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942Boundary
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The actual source-action index, with the read bit as the low bit. -/
+def inputIndex (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) : Fin 430 :=
+  ⟨2*q.val+b.val, by have hq := q.isLt; have hb := b.isLt; omega⟩
+
+theorem inputIndex_val (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val = 2*q.val+b.val := rfl
+
+theorem inputIndex_components (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val / 2 = q.val ∧ (inputIndex q b).val % 2 = b.val := by
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  rw [inputIndex_val]
+  omega
+
+theorem transition_north_eq_index (j : Fin 430) : (transitionRow j).2.north = j.val+2 := by
+  change 2*(j.val/2)+j.val%2+2 = j.val+2
+  omega
+
+theorem operating_head_bounds (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    2 ≤ headColor q.val b.val ∧ headColor q.val b.val ≤ 431 := by
+  have hq := q.isLt
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  unfold headColor
+  omega
+
+theorem indexed_transition_input (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    (transitionRow (inputIndex q b)).2.north = headColor q.val b.val := by
+  rw [transition_north_eq_index, inputIndex_val]
+  rfl
+
+/-- An operating encoded input determines exactly its actual transition row. -/
+theorem north_operating_iff_transition {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t)
+    (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    t.north = headColor q.val b.val ↔ t = (transitionRow (inputIndex q b)).2 := by
+  have hb := operating_head_bounds q b
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    cases ht with
+    | start => simp only [start] at hn; omega
+    | transition j =>
+        have hj : j = inputIndex q b := by
+          apply Fin.ext
+          rw [inputIndex_val]
+          rw [transition_north_eq_index] at hn
+          unfold headColor at hn
+          omega
+        subst j
+        rfl
+    | pass a c =>
+        have ha := a.isLt
+        have hc := c.isLt
+        simp only at hn
+        omega
+    | receive d p hp c => have hc := c.isLt; simp only at hn; omega
+    | finish a c =>
+        have ha := a.isLt
+        have hc := c.isLt
+        simp only at hn
+        omega
+    | initLeft => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initHead => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initRight => simp only at hn; omega
+    | reset p hp => simp only at hn; omega
+    | seam a c => simp only at hn; omega
+  · rintro rfl
+    exact indexed_transition_input q b
+
+theorem halt_head_eq (b : Fin 2) : headColor 215 b.val = 432+b.val := by
+  unfold headColor
+  omega
+
+/-- A halt head can pass unchanged or finish; both alternatives are retained. -/
+theorem north_halt_iff_pass_or_finish {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (b : Fin 2) :
+    t.north = headColor 215 b.val ↔
+      t = ⟨0,432+b.val,0,432+b.val⟩ ∨ t = ⟨0,432+b.val,0,438⟩ := by
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rw [halt_head_eq] at hn
+    cases ht with
+    | start => simp only [start] at hn; omega
+    | transition j => have hj := transition_north_bound j; omega
+    | pass a c => exact Or.inl (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (⟨0,n,0,n⟩ : Tile)) hn)
+    | receive d p hp c => have hc := c.isLt; simp only at hn; omega
+    | finish a c => exact Or.inr (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (⟨0,n,0,438⟩ : Tile)) hn)
+    | initLeft => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initHead => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initRight => simp only at hn; omega
+    | reset p hp => simp only at hn; omega
+    | seam a c => simp only at hn; omega
+  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> exact (halt_head_eq b).symm
+

+  · intro hn
+    cases ht with
+    | start => simp only [start] at hn; omega
+    | transition j => rw [transition_north_eq_index] at hn; omega
+    | pass a c => exact Or.inl (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (⟨0,n,0,n⟩ : Tile)) hn)

+        have hc : c = b := Fin.ext hn

+    | finish a c => exact Or.inr (Or.inl
+        (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (⟨0,n,0,438⟩ : Tile)) hn))
+    | initLeft => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initHead => simp only at hn; omega
+    | initRight => simp only at hn; omega
+    | reset p hp => simp only at hn; omega
+    | seam a c => simp only at hn; omega
+  · rintro (rfl | rfl | ⟨d,q,hq,rfl⟩) <;> rfl
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942InputLanguage

+example : inputIndex (0 : Fin 215) (0 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧
+    inputIndex (214 : Fin 215) (1 : Fin 2) = 429 := by decide +kernel
+
+example : inputIndex (62 : Fin 215) (1 : Fin 2) = 125 ∧

+
+example : (transitionRow (inputIndex (0 : Fin 215) (0 : Fin 2))).2 = ⟨0,2,7,1⟩ := by

+
+example (q : Fin 215) (b : Fin 2) :
+    (inputIndex q b).val / 2 = q.val ∧ (inputIndex q b).val % 2 = b.val :=
+  inputIndex_components q b

+/-!
+# An operating encoded row cannot finish anywhere inside its strip
+
+The unique head input forces its actual transition tile. A finish at any
+interior position would force finish at the head through the next reset
+row, contradicting the transition's Boolean South output. Absence of
+finishes is a conclusion, never an added row-encoding premise.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942OperatingRow
+
+open SetTheory.BusyBeaver
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942InputLanguage
+  WangTiles942RowEncoding WangTiles942StripGeometry WangTiles942ResetRows
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The actual tape read, as the finite bit used by the tile language. -/
+def symbol (cfg : Config 215) (x : ℤ) : Fin 2 :=
+  ⟨(Tape.read cfg.tape x).toNat, by cases Tape.read cfg.tape x <;> decide⟩
+
+theorem operating_head_tile {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {l r t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ)) (h : RowEncodes T l r t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q) :
+    T cfg.head t = (transitionRow (inputIndex q (symbol cfg cfg.head))).2 := by
+  apply (north_operating_iff_transition (hA cfg.head t) q (symbol cfg cfg.head)).mp
+  exact h.operating_head q hq
+
+theorem operating_head_south_le_one {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {l r t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ)) (h : RowEncodes T l r t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q) : (T cfg.head t).south ≤ 1 := by
+  rw [operating_head_tile hA h q hq]
+  change (action (inputIndex q (symbol cfg cfg.head))).1.toNat ≤ 1
+  exact Bool.toNat_le _
+
+/-- One alleged finish would propagate to the actual operating head,
+whose forced transition has South0 or1, not438. -/
+theorem no_south438 {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} {t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ))
+    (hH : ∀ x τ, (T (x+1) τ).west = (T x τ).east)
+    (hTime : ∀ x τ, (T x (τ+1)).north = (T x τ).south)
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R)
+    (h : RowEncodes T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (x : ℤ) (hl : -(L : ℤ) < x) (hr : x < (R : ℤ)) : (T x t).south ≠ 438 := by
+  intro hf
+  have hrow := strip_finish_and_reset_of_south438 T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) x t
+    (fun x τ _ _ => hA x τ) (fun x τ _ _ => hH x τ)
+    (fun x τ _ _ => hTime x τ)
+    (fun x τ hxl hxr => (hs.interior x hxl hxr τ).1) hl hr hf
+  have hh := (hrow cfg.head h.head_left h.head_right).2.1
+  have hb := operating_head_south_le_one hA h q hq
+  omega
+
+theorem no_finish {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} {N L R : ℕ} {t : ℤ} {cfg : Config 215}
+    (hA : ∀ x τ, Allowed (T x τ))
+    (hH : ∀ x τ, (T (x+1) τ).west = (T x τ).east)
+    (hTime : ∀ x τ, (T x (τ+1)).north = (T x τ).south)
+    (hs : PersistentStrip T N L R)
+    (h : RowEncodes T (-(L : ℤ)) (R : ℤ) t cfg)
+    (q : Fin 215) (hq : cfg.state = some q)
+    (x : ℤ) (hl : -(L : ℤ) < x) (hr : x < (R : ℤ)) : ¬ FinishTile (T x t) := by
+  intro hf
+  exact no_south438 hA hH hTime hs h q hq x hl hr hf.south
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942OperatingRow

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language
+
+/-!
+# Exact horizontal reset color in the actual finite tile language
+
+A horizontal color 1 belongs only to a reset tile or an explicit seam
+tile. The seam exception is retained in both directions. These are local
+finite-table statements, not a claim that any whole row is a reset row.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942ResetHorizontal
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Every possible allowed tile with a horizontal edge of color 1. -/
+theorem horizontal_one_cases {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t)
+    (h1 : t.west = 1 ∨ t.east = 1) :
+    (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) ∨
+    (∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩) := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => norm_num [start] at h1
+  | transition j =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range (action_target_mem j)).1
+      dsimp only [transitionRow] at h1
+      cases hd : (action j).2.1 <;>
+        simp only [hd, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero,
+          Nat.sub_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] at * <;> omega
+  | pass a b => norm_num at h1
+  | receive d q hq b =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range hq).1
+      cases d <;> simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero,
+        Nat.sub_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] at h1 hr <;> omega
+  | finish a b => norm_num at h1
+  | initLeft => norm_num at h1
+  | initHead => norm_num at h1
+  | initRight => norm_num at h1
+  | reset p hp => exact Or.inl ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
+  | seam a b => exact Or.inr ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+
+/-- West 1 may also be a seam with its square parameter equal to 1. -/
+theorem west_1_iff_reset_or_seam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.west = 1 ↔ (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) ∨
+      (∃ b : Fin 3, t = ⟨1,437,b.val,437⟩) := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hw
+    rcases horizontal_one_cases ht (Or.inl hw) with hr | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · exact Or.inl hr
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨b, by simp only [show a.val^2 = 1 from hw]⟩
+  · rintro (⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨b,rfl⟩) <;> rfl
+
+/-- East 1 may be a seam with any of the three west square parameters. -/
+theorem east_1_iff_reset_or_seam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.east = 1 ↔ (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) ∨
+      (∃ a : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,1,437⟩) := by
+  constructor
+  · intro he
+    rcases horizontal_one_cases ht (Or.inr he) with hr | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · exact Or.inl hr
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨a, by simp only [show b.val = 1 from he]⟩
+  · rintro (⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,rfl⟩) <;> rfl
+
+/-- The nonseam premise is explicit; without it a seam counterexample remains. -/
+theorem west_1_nonseam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (hw : t.west = 1)
+    (hn : t.north ≠ 437) : ∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ := by
+  rcases (west_1_iff_reset_or_seam ht).mp hw with hr | ⟨b,rfl⟩
+  · exact hr
+  · exact False.elim (hn rfl)
+
+theorem east_1_nonseam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (he : t.east = 1)
+    (hn : t.north ≠ 437) : ∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ := by
+  rcases (east_1_iff_reset_or_seam ht).mp he with hr | ⟨a,rfl⟩
+  · exact hr
+  · exact False.elim (hn rfl)
+
+theorem horizontal_one_nonseam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t)
+    (h1 : t.west = 1 ∨ t.east = 1) (hn : t.north ≠ 437) :
+    ∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ := by
+  rcases h1 with hw | he
+  · exact west_1_nonseam ht hw hn
+  · exact east_1_nonseam ht he hn
+
+/-- A direct local corollary for subsequent color matching. -/
+theorem north_438_of_horizontal_one_nonseam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t)
+    (h1 : t.west = 1 ∨ t.east = 1) (hn : t.north ≠ 437) : t.north = 438 := by
+  obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := horizontal_one_nonseam ht h1 hn
+  rfl
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942ResetHorizontal

+
+/-! Checks of every reset alternative and indispensable seam exceptions.
+No propagation to a whole row, computation, or halting is asserted. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942ResetHorizontalChecks
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942ResetHorizontal
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+
+example {d : Bool} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets d) : rail d q ≠ 1 := by
+  have h := (valid_rail_range hq).1
+  omega
+
+example (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ [434,435,436]) : Allowed (⟨1,438,1,p⟩ : Tile) :=
+  Allowed.reset p hp
+
+-- West 1 must preserve every possible seam east parameter.
+example (b : Fin 3) : Allowed (⟨1,437,b.val,437⟩ : Tile) :=
+  Allowed.seam (1 : Fin 3) b
+
+-- East 1 must preserve all three west square parameters, including 0 and 4.
+example (a : Fin 3) : Allowed (⟨a.val^2,437,1,437⟩ : Tile) :=
+  Allowed.seam a (1 : Fin 3)
+
+example : Allowed (⟨0,437,1,437⟩ : Tile) ∧ Allowed (⟨4,437,1,437⟩ : Tile) :=
+  ⟨Allowed.seam (0 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 3), Allowed.seam (2 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 3)⟩
+
+-- Even both horizontal edges being 1 does not force reset without nonseam.
+example : Allowed (⟨1,437,1,437⟩ : Tile) ∧
+    ¬ (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], (⟨1,437,1,437⟩ : Tile) = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) := by
+  refine ⟨Allowed.seam (1 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 3), ?_⟩
+  rintro ⟨p,hp,he⟩
+  have hn := congrArg Tile.north he
+  norm_num at hn
+
+-- A forged reset with an unlisted south color is excluded.
+example : ¬ Allowed (⟨1,438,1,433⟩ : Tile) := by
+  intro h
+  obtain ⟨p,hp,he⟩ := west_1_nonseam h rfl (by decide)
+  have hs := congrArg Tile.south he
+  simp only at hs
+  subst p
+  norm_num at hp
+
+example (i : Fin 942) (hw : (tile i).west = 1) (hn : (tile i).north ≠ 437) :
+    ∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], tile i = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ :=
+  west_1_nonseam (tile_allowed i) hw hn
+
+example (i : Fin 942) (he : (tile i).east = 1) (hn : (tile i).north ≠ 437) :
+    (tile i).north = 438 :=
+  north_438_of_horizontal_one_nonseam (tile_allowed i) (Or.inr he) hn
+
+example {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (h1 : t.west = 1 ∨ t.east = 1)
+    (hn : t.north ≠ 437) : t.west = 1 ∧ t.east = 1 := by
+  obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := horizontal_one_nonseam ht h1 hn
+  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
+
+#print axioms horizontal_one_cases
+#print axioms west_1_iff_reset_or_seam
+#print axioms east_1_iff_reset_or_seam
+#print axioms west_1_nonseam
+#print axioms east_1_nonseam
+#print axioms horizontal_one_nonseam

+
